decisions.statement: A transcript line this module cannot read is passed over rather than refused.
A message is injected only where the transcript has the injection itself.
A message the seat found in its own inbox is apart from a message the channel injected.
A message is overtaken where a message queued after is injected instead.
A message still unseen more than four turns after that message was queued is lost.
A message the session ended without showing is lost.
A seat mid-turn reads the same as a seat that swallowed the message.
A transcript with no enqueue of the message is absent rather than lost.
One injected transcript settles the whole set however many transcripts saw nothing.

definition: what a seat's transcript says became of a channel message queued to that seat
